Maria (eng-platform): Heads up — since the 03:00 deploy we've seen a spike in 502s for APAC users, looks correlated with egress NAT SNAT port exhaustion on the eu->apac fallback path.
Anil (eng-infra): Yep, Grafana shows NAT port allocation at ~98% on eu-egress-01 and connection churn is high. Any routing changes rolled recently?
Maria (eng-platform): We flipped the low-latency geo policy to prefer eu->apac-warm for a subset of traffic to shave RTT. Fallback still immediate on probe fail. Suspect immediate failovers are thrashing SNAT pools.
Sasha (eng-sre): Can you paste the probe logs and the geo policy snippet? Need to confirm probe timing + backoff behavior.
Maria (eng-platform): ```json
{"probe":"apac-health","target":"apac-warm","status":"502","latency_ms":1350,"region":"apac-warm"}
```
Anil (eng-infra): That matches: probe window=6s, grace_period=0s, backoff=none. So a single transient causes immediate re-route. When traffic flips to apac-warm we create new SNAT mappings and then fail back — oscillation.
Keith (oncall): Quick mitigation: prefer local region egress when SNAT utilization > 85% to avoid cross-region migrations. Applying a temporary geo override now: `geo_policy.override = prefer-local-if-snat>85`
deploy-bot: started deploy for config/geo/1901234567-temp-geo-override.json @ 1901234670
Sasha (eng-sre): Also recommend enabling sticky_egress_session for 30m on routes that are failing so sessions don't bounce during transient congestion.
Anil (eng-infra): I'll push a probe backoff change and add a fallback warmup: `probe.backoff: exponential; probe.base: 2s; probe.max_backoff: 60s; fallback.warmup: 30s; sticky_egress_session: 1800s`
Anil (eng-infra): Pushed config; rolling restart of geo-proxy pods on eu region now.
Maria (eng-platform): After changes we're seeing 502 rate drop ~80% and SNAT port usage down to 63% within 10m. Monitoring for 1h.
Sasha (eng-sre): Please capture the timeline + graphs for postmortem. Also add a cost line item: cross-region failovers generated ~3TB egress over last 6h, ~ $3.2k bandwidth + NAT allocation pressure.
Maria (eng-platform): Will file a short postmortem in #postmortems with config diffs and suggested defaults (probe.grace_period >= 20s, backoff enabled, fallback warmup). Thanks team :heart:
ops-bot: Incident auto-closed at 1901234890 (no active alerts).
